NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Zoning Code Amendment - Floor Area Ratio, Lot Coverage, and Objective Design Standards for Residential Neighborhoods - The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding the addition of Floor Area Ratio and Lot Coverage as development standards in the areas within the City of Azusa that have Neighborhood zoning designations. The ordinance would also include Objective Design Standards for these areas. The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3).
